**Does rustic already do this?**
rusticprofile deliberately delegates all backup configuration — repository, sources, excludes, retention, hooks, metrics — to rustic's own config. Requests for those belong upstream. This project owns scheduling, per-host gating, sequencing, exit classification and lock coordination.
